44301686.article_content:
So I was uh, downloading some linux isos, like usual. It was going slowly, so I opened up the
Trackers
tab in qBittorrent and saw the following:
Most of the trackers were totally dead.
Either the hosts were down or the domains werenât being used.
That got me thinking.
What if
I
picked up one of these dead domains?
How many clients would try to connect?
What are trackers for, anyways?
A
tracker
is a core component of the
BitTorrent protocol
. Trackers are the services that point you to other peers for the torrent. Without trackers, there would be no one to share the file with.
Obviously this represents a major source of centralization in the torrent protocol. If your trackers arenât maintained â or if they get forced offline by certain industry organizations â youâre out of luck.
We have an alternative, called
Mainline DHT
, which performs a more decentralized lookup of peers based on infohash alone. DHT isnât perfect, though. It relies on
bootstrap nodes
and is vulnerable to
Sybil attacks
. And in the example of my poorly-served torrent, DHT wasnât surfacing any peers, regardless.
Hosting a tracker
Looking through the list of trackers marked âhost not foundâ, I noticed
udp://open.demonii.si:1337/announce
was available.
I bought the domain through
Dynadot
(one of the few .si domain registrars), then spun up a
quick anonymous VPS
. I mapped the domain to the VPS, then set up
opentracker
, the most widely used and robust torrent tracker software.
Instructions for Ubuntu 24.04:
sudo
apt
install
gcc-14 g++-14 build-essential zlib1g-dev
sudo
update-alternatives
--install
/usr/bin/gcc gcc /usr/bin/gcc-14 14
sudo
update-alternatives
--install
/usr/bin/g++ g++ /usr/bin/g++-14 14
Follow the
readme
to compile, first the dependency
libowfat
(a GPL reimplementation of some of
dan bernstein
âs C libraries) and then opentracker itself.
cvs
-d
:pserver:cvs@cvs.fefe.de:/cvs
-z9
co libowfat
cd
libowfat
make
cd
..
git clone git://erdgeist.org/opentracker
cd
opentracker
make
Finally, a quick systemd unit file to daemonize this service:
[
Unit]
Description
=
opentracker
After
=
network-online.target
Wants
=
network-online.target
[
Service]
Type
=
simple
User
=
opentracker
Group
=
opentracker
WorkingDirectory
=
/var/lib/opentracker
ExecStart
=
/home/opentracker/opentracker/opentracker
-p
1337
-P
1337
\
-d
/var/lib/opentracker
-u
opentracker
Restart
=
on-failure
LimitNOFILE
=
65536
[
Install]
WantedBy
=
multi-user.target
What did I find?
Before even starting opentracker, I saw a flood of traffic against UDP port 1337:
I then started the tracker. After about an hour, it peaked at about
1.7 million distinct torrents across 3.1 million peers!

data.author: crescit_eundo
data.article_summary: 本文主要介绍了一个开源项目COSIG（**Collaborative Open Science Integrity Guides**），该项目旨在通过提供指南，帮助人们参与发表后的同行评审、科学文献的监督及科学 meta 分析。虽然审查科学文献的完整性通常需要特定领域的知识，但该项目通过专家编写的指南分享这些知识，让更多人能够参与。COSIG 包含28个指南，涵盖了从PubPeer评论最佳实践到图像查重等各类主题，并提供了单独和合并的PDF下载链接。项目还鼓励通过GitHub或邮件提交改进建议，并提供了贡献指南和行为准则。

主要讨论点： post-publication peer review 的价值及其在减少认知偏差和科研自大中的作用

不同观点：
• btilly 的观点：  
  - 认为 post-publication peer review 极为重要，因为它提供了一种反馈机制，帮助个人和科学领域减少认知偏差和过度自信。  
  - 提出认知偏差中的“认知失调”会导致人们拒绝承认自己的不足，尤其是在他们在乎的领域。这种现象在编程和科学研究中普遍存在。  
  - 举例说明避免自大、接受反馈对持续进步的重要性，并提到像“程序员的十诫”这样的规则可以帮助避免自我膨胀。  
  - 尽管 post-publication peer review 本身不能完全解决问题，但它是一个必要的反馈环节，有助于非专业人士判断哪些领域值得信任。

• crescit_eundo 的观点：  
  - 引用项目介绍，指出任何人都可以参与 post-publication peer review，但调查科学文献的完整性通常需要领域特定的知识。  
  - 强调开放项目的目标是传播特定领域的知识，使更多人能够参与 post-publication peer review。

补充讨论：
• btilly 强调了认知偏差对科学研究的影响，特别是过度自信如何导致错误被忽视和反对证据被拒绝。

### **Anyone can do post-publication peer review.**
### **Anyone can be a steward of the scientific literature.**
### **Anyone can do forensic metascience.**
### **Anyone can sleuth.**
However, investigating the integrity of the published scientific literature often requires domain-specific knowledge that not everyone will have. This open source project is a collection of guides written and maintained by publication integrity experts to distribute this domain-specific knowledge so that others can participate in post-publication peer review.
COSIG currently hosts 28 guides and was last updated on 13 June 2025. Guides can be downloaded as [individual PDFs](https://osf.io/2kdez/files/osfstorage). A combined PDF with all guides included can be downloaded [here](https://osf.io/ynb8j).
Suggestions to improve COSIG can be submitted by opening an issue on [COSIG's GitHub repo](https://github.com/cosig-pppr/cosig/issues) or by emailing [admin@cosig.net](mailto:admin@cosig.net). Before contributing, read COSIG's [Contributing](https://github.com/cosig-pppr/cosig/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/cosig-pppr/cosig/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) pages.

• franze：大量使用Claude Code，并结合O3-Pro解决代码问题，希望能有更好的集成。
• starik36：尝试O3-Pro处理法律邮件解析，发现非Pro版本结果更一致，但因O1-preview即将下线，必须迁移到O3。
• iLoveOncall：认为长时间等待让人不愿使用慢速模型，非推理模型在多数情况下表现相同。

• A_D_E_P_T：认为聊天格式不适合需要长时间响应的工具，建议使用类似电子邮件的方式进行详细提示和响应交换，并指出O3-Pro的响应速度有所改善。
• 争议焦点：O3-Pro的响应速度和适用场景是主要争议点，部分用户认为长响应时间影响使用体验，而另一部分用户则认为其在特定场景下是优势。

data.title: Honda Conducts Successful Launch and Landing of Experimental Reusable Rocket
data.author: LorenDB
data.article_summary: 2025年6月17日，本田研发公司成功进行了自主研发的可重复使用火箭（长6.3米，直径85厘米，干重900公斤，湿重1,312公斤）的发射和着陆测试。火箭在达到300米高度后顺利着陆，验证了火箭在上升和下降过程中的飞行稳定性及着陆能力等关键技术。测试在日本北海道大樹町的本田设施进行，火箭达到了271.4米的飞行高度，并在预定着陆点37厘米范围内着陆，飞行持续56.6秒。本田自2024年起已在该地安全进行多次引擎点火和悬停测试，此次测试同样采取了严格的安全措施，设立了半径1公里的禁入区域。本田希望通过研发可重复使用火箭，实现其在太空技术领域的梦想，为人们日常生活创造更多价值，并应对未来卫星发射需求的增长。

Topics
Honda Conducts Successful Launch and Landing Test of Experimental Reusable Rocket
TOKYO, Japan, June 17, 2025 â Honda R&D Co., Ltd., a research and development subsidiary of Honda Motor Co., Ltd., today conducted a launch and landing test of an experimental reusable rocket
*1
(6.3 m in length, 85 cm in diameter, 900 kg dry weight/1,312 kg wet weight) developed independently by Honda. The test was completed successfully, the first time Honda landed a rocket after reaching an altitude of 300 meters.
This test marked the first launch and landing test conducted by Honda with an aim to demonstrate key technologies essential for rocket reusability, such as flight stability during ascent and descent, as well as landing capability. Through this successful test, Honda achieved its intended rocket behaviors for the launch and landing (reaching an altitude of 271.4 m, and landing at 37cm of the target touchdown point, flight duration 56.6 sec), while obtaining data during the ascent and descent.
ï¼Overview of launch and landing test of a Honda reusable rocketï¼
ã»Purpose:Â Â Â Â  Establishment of key technologies necessary for a reusable rocket
ã»Location:Â Â Â Â  Honda facility in Taiki Town
*2
, Hiroo District, Hokkaido Prefecture, Japan
ã»Date/Time:Â  June 17, 2025. Launch time: 16:15
Test being conducted in Taiki Town in Hokkaido, Japan(Photo taken in May, 2025)
Launch and landing test
*1 A reusable rocket, also known as a reusable launch vehicle (RLV), is a type of rocket that, unlike a conventional expendable launch vehicle (ELV), can be used repeatedly in a short period of time. A reusable rocket is launched in a vertical position, reaches an altitude of around 100 kilometers, and then lands back on earth while maintaining a vertical position.
*2 Taiki Town, located in southeastern Hokkaido, Japan, has been developing itself as a âspace townâ through the joint efforts of public and private sectors, and various aviation/space related tests are being conducted by a wide range of organizations including JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency), businesses and universities.
ï¼Safety measures for Honda rocket testingï¼
Since 2024, Honda has been safely conducting engine combustion tests and hovering tests for its reusable rockets in Taiki Town in Hiroo District, Hokkaido, Japan. As with all previous tests, Honda conducted this launch and landing test while placing the highest priority on safety and with the understanding and cooperation of local authorities and residents.Â
Specific safety measures taken for this test
A restricted area with a 1-kilometer radius was established. During the test, access to the area was restricted through the installation of signs and gates, as well as the deployment of security personnel.
The restricted area was defined by calculating the potential area where the rocket could fall to earth in the event of a thrust cut-off and by adding a sufficient buffer zone (safe distance calculated based on the guidelines set forth by the Cabinet Office of the Government of Japan) that would cover the potential area where a blast wave, debris dispersion, or fireballs could impact in the event of an explosion within the potential fall area.
The experimental rocket was equipped with a safety system to prevent deviation from a pre-defined flight corridor, speed and attitude conditions, ensuring no impact beyond the restricted area.
ï¼Honda initiatives in the areas of rocket researchï¼
As announced in 2021, Honda has been pursuing research and development in the field of space technologies while viewing it as a place to take on challenges to realize the âdreamsâ and âpotentialâ of people worldwide while leveraging its core technologies. Honda has the aim to enable people to transcend the constraints of time, place or ability and make peopleâs daily lives more enjoyable. Examples of Honda initiatives toward creating new value in the ultimate environment of outer space include research into a circulative renewable energy system, key robotic technologies for use in outer space and reusable rockets.Â
Inspired by the dream of young Honda engineers who wanted to build rockets by utilizing core technologies amassed by Honda through the development of various products, such as combustion and control technologies, Honda started rocket research based on the belief that it has the potential to contribute more to peopleâs daily lives by launching satellites with its own rockets, that could lead to various services
*3
that are also compatible with other Honda business.
In todayâs world, vast amounts of data are consumed, with the growing expectation for greater utilization of a data system in outer space through expanded use of satellites. In light of this trend, the need for satellite launch rockets is also expected to increase in the coming years.
In this market environment, Honda has chosen to take on the technological challenge of developing reusable rockets by

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于电力运营商REE在一次停电事件中的责任及其与政府关系的争议

不同观点：
• narag认为，REE并非纯粹的私营企业，而是由政府控制的混合资本企业。其 boss由执政党指派，且在停电事件中可能因追求太阳能发电记录而推翻了技术人员的意见，导致了停电。此外，narag指出，官方声明中故意回避了核能的问题，而私营公司则要求公布CECOEL对话的记录，其中一些泄露的日志显示，REE技术人员承认波动是由于核能不足。

• tux3提供了最新的信息，指出报告已经提交，但尚未公开。他们引用了新闻发布链接，显示官方对此事件的回应和信息发布情况。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于REE的企业性质及其在停电事件中的责任。narag质疑官方叙述的真实性，并指出政府对核能的态度可能影响电力系统的稳定性。

data.title: We're expanding our Gemini 2.5 family of models
data.author: meetpateltech
data.article_summary: 谷歌Gemini团队宣布扩展其Gemini 2.5模型系列。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Pro版本现已正式发布，具有高性能、成本和速度的优势。此外，他们还推出了Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite预览版，这是迄今为止最具成本效益和速度最快的2.5模型，具备更高的编码、数学、科学、推理等多方面能力，适用于高容量、低延迟的任务。开发者可以在Google AI Studio和Vertex AI中使用Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite预览版及稳定的Flash和Pro版本，并期待用户反馈。详细信息可参阅最新的Gemini技术报告。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Gemini 2.5 Flash模型的价格、性能、实用性及相关技术问题

不同观点：
• **价格变化的观点**：
  - **simonw**：指出Gemini 2.5 Flash模型价格调整，取消了thinking和non-thinking的区别，整体价格有所上升，特别是output价格显著提高。
  - **serjester**：对统一thinking和non-thinking价格表示欢迎，但不满整体价格上涨，尤其是曾因忘记配置参数而意外多花费数千美元。

• **性能和实用性观点**：
  - **varun_chopra**：认为Gemini Pro曾是许多人首选，但现在表现下降，转回使用Claude。Gemini适合头脑风暴，但不适合严肃工作。
  - **lvl155**：对Gemini非常满意，已经停止使用OpenAI，主要使用Gemini，相比去年更偏好Gemini。
  - **b0a04gl**：测试Gemini Flash Lite，发现延迟低但质量不稳定，尤其在递归或结构化内容上表现不佳。
  - **zzleeper**：认为Gemini 2.5在非trivial任务上表现不佳，遇到API限制问题，最终转回OpenAI。
  - **GaggiX**：认为2.5 Flash Lite在多数任务上优于2.0 Flash Lite，但在SimpleQA上略逊一筹。

• **技术问题和困扰**：
  - **zelias**：遇到Gemini 2.5模型通过API返回空内容的问题，寻求解决方案。
  - **2Gkashmiri**：遇到大文件处理时context窗口快速丢失的问题。

• **其他讨论**：
  - **jbellis**：认为Gemini Flash Lite在编写代码上变得有用，但质疑thinking模型的速度优势，并好奇其他人的使用场景。
  - **candiddevmike**：好奇Gemini在编码之外的应用场景，讨论了多模型切换、负载平衡和潜在的LLM现货市场。
  - **heliophobicdude**：期待Gemini Diffusion模型的发布，认为它会取代Aider的默认模型。

补充讨论：
- **不同用户间的体验差异**：一些用户如lvl155对Gemini非常满意，而另一些用户如varun_chopra和zzleeper则因性能和限制问题转回其他模型。
- **价格和性能的平衡**：用户对Gemini价格上涨和性能表现之间的关系表示关注，尤其是实用性和价格的匹配度。
- **技术问题和支持**：zelias和2Gkashmiri分别遇到的API返回空内容和文件处理问题反映了技术上的挑战，用户希望获得解决方案。

争议焦点：Gemini 2.5模型价格上涨是否合理，以及其性能是否能匹配用户需求。

data.title: Voyager: Real-Time Splatting City-Scale 3D Gaussians on Your Phone
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一种名为Voyager的系统，能够在移动设备上实时渲染城市规模的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）场景。由于移动设备资源有限，直接渲染此类场景存在困难。Voyager通过云端进行计算，但仅将用户视角中必要的高斯函数传输到客户端，以减少数据传输和延迟。云端采用异步细节层次搜索，客户端则通过查表式光栅化加速渲染。实验表明，Voyager在数据传输量上减少了超过100倍，速度提升最高达8.9倍，同时保持了相当的渲染质量。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于图形渲染技术（尤其是“splatting”技术）在移动设备和云端的实现与优化

不同观点：
• reactordev：自2023年起在Faro Inc从事相关工作，并参与构建了该技术。他认为现代移动设备GPU性能强大，可以在几何着色器中实现查找光栅化（lookup rasterization），这是技术的核心。

• ge96：对最近频繁看到“splatting”技术表示疑惑，认为这是旧技术，不知为何重新流行。

• jauntywundrkind：询问是否已有部分渲染卸载到云端的实例，并分享了一种优化方案。他指出“splatting”本质上是一个搜索问题，可以卸载到云端处理。具体方法包括在云端进行异步细节层次搜索，以确定客户端所需的Gaussians，并在客户端通过基于查找表的光栅化加速渲染。

• modeless：询问是否有相关技术的 demo 演示，以更直观地理解该技术的实际应用。

补充讨论：
• reactordev 强调了现代移动设备GPU的性能进步，使得复杂渲染操作可以在本地设备上高效完成。
• ge96 对“splatting”技术重新受到关注表示不解，暗示该技术可能已经过时或被取代。
• jauntywundrkind 提出了云端与客户端协作的优化方案，强调了云端处理搜索问题和客户端加速渲染的结合。
• modeless 关注实际演示，希望通过demo更深入理解该技术的实际效果。

争议焦点：
• “splatting”技术是否为过时的技术，以及其重新受到关注的原因。

View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is an emerging technique for photorealistic 3D scene rendering. However, rendering city-scale 3DGS scenes on mobile devices, e.g., your smartphones, remains a significant challenge due to the limited resources on mobile devices. A natural solution is to offload computation to the cloud; however, naively streaming rendered frames from the cloud to the client introduces high latency and requires bandwidth far beyond the capacity of current wireless networks.
In this paper, we propose an effective solution to enable city-scale 3DGS rendering on mobile devices. Our key insight is that, under normal user motion, the number of newly visible Gaussians per second remains roughly constant. Leveraging this, we stream only the necessary Gaussians to the client. Specifically, on the cloud side, we propose asynchronous level-of-detail search to identify the necessary Gaussians for the client. On the client side, we accelerate rendering via a lookup table-based rasterization. Combined with holistic runtime optimizations, our system can deliver low-latency, city-scale 3DGS rendering on mobile devices. Compared to existing solutions, Voyager achieves over 100$\times$ reduction on data transfer and up to 8.9$\times$ speedup while retaining comparable rendering quality.

data.title: Cmapv2: A high performance, concurrent map
data.author: sirgallo
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Go语言中的一个并发哈希数组映射前缀树（concurrent hash array mapped trie）实现，名为cmapv2。该项目提供了安装和使用指南，用户可以通过`go get`命令将其集成到自己的Go项目中。cmapv2支持常规的键值对插入、获取和删除操作，并且可以初始化分片的并发地图（sharded c map）以提高性能。项目包含测试代码和性能分析指南，用户可以通过运行测试命令和性能分析工具来评估其表现。该项目基于MIT许可证发布。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同并发地图（concurrent map）实现的性能比较

不同观点：
• sirgallo认为cmapv2在性能上与Go的sync.Map相当，甚至在某些工作负载下表现更好。他指出cmapv2是无锁且线程安全的，使用原子操作，并且天然支持分片。他还提供了具体的性能数据，提到在1000万个键值对（每个键值均为64字节）的情况下，cmapv2可以达到每秒150万次写操作和300万次读操作。

• gttalbot对cmapv2的性能表示怀疑，并提出了它是否接近"swisstables"（瑞士表，Go 1.18中引入的一种高效哈希表实现）的问题，暗示可能存在其他更高效的并发地图实现。

补充讨论：
• sirgallo提供了具体的性能指标和cmapv2的优势，如无锁设计和分片支持。
• gttalbot的评论引发了对不同并发地图实现之间的比较，特别是与Go 1.18中引入的瑞士表的比较，这是一个重要的讨论点，因为瑞士表在许多场景下表现出色。
• 争议的焦点在于cmapv2是否真的在性能上具有优势，特别是在与其他高性能实现（如瑞士表）比较时。

• 争议的焦点在于cmapv2是否真的在性能上具有优势，特别是在与其他高性能实现（如瑞士表）比较时。

data.title: CPU-Based Layout Design for Picker-to-Parts Pallet Warehouses
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种受CPU架构启发的仓储布局设计，用于优化“拣货到零件”的托盘仓库效率。该设计将仓库空间划分为性能区（P）、效率区（E）和共享区（S），并通过离散事件模拟与传统布局（如矩形和Flying-V布局）进行对比。结果显示，该设计显著提高了吞吐量并减少了人工需求。文章由Timo Looms和Lin Xie撰写，发表于arXiv，共8页，包含6个图表，适用于多智能体系统领域。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对模拟仓库中不同区域划分策略的有效性及其原理的分析

不同观点：
• Kens认为，该模拟并没有真正实现他所期望的“基于CPU”的理念，只是借用了类似CPU中“性能核心”和“效率核心”的概念。他认为这种区域划分（Performance Zone、Efficiency Zone、Shared Zone）更像是对CPU核心架构的简单类比。
• Kens对模拟结果表示了一定的认可，指出模拟显示这种分区策略是最有效的，但他同时批评了论文没有深入探讨为什么这种策略会表现最佳。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到了对“性能区”和“效率区”的划分，以及它们分别用于存放高频和低频需求的物品，并且还有共享区用于中频物品和溢出。这一设计显然在实践中有效，但缺乏对其背后原理的深入分析。
• Kens显然对论文没有解释该策略为何最优感到失望，表明他希望看到更深入的理论探讨或数据支持，而不仅仅是表面效果的展示。

Abstract:
Picker-to-parts pallet warehouses often face inefficiencies due to conventional layouts causing excessive travel distances and high labor requirements. This study introduces a novel layout design inspired by CPU architecture, partitioning warehouse space into specialized zones, namely Performance (P), Efficiency (E), and Shared (S). Discrete-event simulation is used to evaluate this design against traditional rectangular (random and ABC storage) and Flying-V layouts. Results demonstrate significant improvements in throughput time and reduced labor requirements, highlighting the potential for CPU-based layouts in optimizing warehouse operations.

data.author: nathanfig
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI工具对软件开发及开发者角色影响的讨论

不同观点：
• [psunavy03] 认为新工具（如COBOL）的发明可以让非技术人员编写代码，减少对高薪开发者的依赖。这种观点强调了工具降低技术门槛的可能性。
• [dehrmann] 提出了Jevons悖论的适用条件，指出软件需求弹性及AI能力上限是不确定的，暗示技术进步未必会大幅减少开发者需求。
• [nathanfig] 提供了一种反叙事，反对过度悲观的“毁灭论”，认为软件开发者的价值依然存在，并邀请其他人批评其观点。
• [abalashov] 部分同意技术提升效率的观点，但认为效率提升不如农业机械化那么显著。强调开发者的价值从“编码”转向业务逻辑理解和问题解决能力。
• [karczex] 用Fortran的例子类比，认为历史上类似工具并未彻底取代开发者，暗示新工具可能也不会完全替代开发者。

补充讨论：
• [yodsanklai] 分享了个人经验，指出即使有AI编写代码，仍需要人工审查和重写，表明AI工具目前尚不能完全取代人类开发者。
• [waffletower] 提到了一个相关资源（braveclojure.com），显示出对开发者社区和学习资源的关注。
• [SeanDav] 澄清了评论中的一个术语错误，表明对讨论中技术细节的关注。
• [freekh] 对文章表示赞同，简单支持了其中观点。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于AI工具是否会大幅减少对专业软件开发者的需求，以及这些工具在实际应用中的效率和效果。

data.title: Celebrated pianist and writer Alfred Brendel dies aged 94
data.author: mykowebhn
data.article_summary: 阿尔弗雷德·布伦德尔（Alfred Brendel），著名钢琴家兼作家，于2025年6月17日在伦敦去世，享年94岁。他出生于摩拉维亚，童年在克罗地亚和奥地利度过，16岁后自学成才。1949年，他获得布索尼比赛第四名，开启了演奏生涯。布伦德尔以演绎贝多芬作品闻名，是首位录制贝多芬全部钢琴作品的钢琴家，同时推动了海顿、舒伯特和勋伯格等人作品的复兴。他移居伦敦后，于1971年定居汉普斯特德，育有三个孩子。2008年在维也纳举行最后一场公开音乐会，之后继续出版诗歌和散文，并授课。他被誉为“音乐家的音乐家”和“钢琴家的导师”，学生包括保罗·刘易斯和伊莫金·库珀等。他获得了23个荣誉学位和多项国际大奖，其逝世是音乐界的巨大损失。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对钢琴家Alfred Brendel的评价和怀念

不同观点：
• mykowebhn认为Alfred Brendel是他最喜欢的钢琴家之一。他特别提到Brendel录制的完整贝多芬奏鸣曲无与伦比，其理智的演奏方法与情感表达完美平衡，甚至能感动到流泪。尽管没有现场看过他的演出，但曾在Brendel退休后听过他在哈佛的演讲，并认为他是一个伟大的音乐家，表示怀念。

补充讨论：
• toomuchtodo没有直接发表观点，但通过提供多个链接（包括维基百科、Brendel的个人网站以及相关采访和节目链接），为讨论提供了更多背景信息和资源，帮助其他读者进一步了解Alfred Brendel的生平和作品。

争议焦点：
• 评论中未见直接的争议，但mykowebhn对Brendel演奏的高度赞扬表明了他个人的强烈喜好和主观评价，而这种评价可能并不为所有人认同，尤其是在艺术欣赏方面，不同听众可能有不同的偏好和感受。

44301246.article_content:
Alfred Brendel in 2010.
Photograph: unknown/Sophia Evans
View image in fullscreen
Alfred Brendel in 2010.
Photograph: unknown/Sophia Evans
Classical music
Celebrated pianist and writer Alfred Brendel dies aged 94
Widely regarded as the ‘musicians’ musician’ Brendel was the first pianist to record all of Beethoven’s piano works during a much-garlanded career spanning 60 years
Imogen Tilden
Tue 17 Jun 2025 12.24 EDT
Last modified on Tue 17 Jun 2025 12.47 EDT
Share
The celebrated pianist and author
Alfred Brendel
has died aged 94 at his home in London.
The musician was born on 5 January 1931 in Moravia (now part of the Czech Republic) and spent his childhood mainly in Croatia and Austria. “I was not a child prodigy or eastern European or Jewish as far as I know,”
he told interviewers
. “I’m not a good sight reader, I don’t have a phenomenal memory and I didn’t come from a musical family, an artistic family or an intellectual family. I had loving parents, but I had to find things out for myself.”
He studied piano and composition until he was 16,
thereafter he was largely self-taught
. Aged 17 he gave his first public recital in Graz with works by Bach, Brahms and Liszt on the programme, one of the encores was his own composition – a sonata with a double fugue. The teenage Brendel was also an author and an exhibited painter, but in 1949 he won fourth prize in the prestigious Busoni competition, which launched his career as a performing musician.
His concert and recording career lasted more than 60 years with performances at the world’s most important musical centres and festivals alongside the leading orchestras and conductors. He became particularly associated with the music of Beethoven, and made the first complete recording of the composer’s entire piano music. He took a prominent role in highlighting Haydn’s importance as a composer
,
in establishing
Schubert’s Sonatas and Schoenberg’s Concerto in the repertoire, and rekindling interest in Liszt’s piano music. He moved to London in 1971, and made his home in Hampstead, his second marriage brought three children (his son,
Adrian is an acclaimed cellist
, his daughter by his first,
Doris, is a pop and rock singer
). His final public
concert was in Vienna in 2008
but in the succeeding years he published poetry and essays, lectured and continued to teach and give masterclasses.
View image in fullscreen
Inspirational and uncompromising: Alfred Brendel.
Photograph: Benjamin Ealovega
“I don’t feel guilty about being ‘intellectual’ if that means thinking about the structure and character and humour in a piece of music,”
he told the Guardian in 2010
on the occasion of receiving Gramophone magazine’s Lifetime Achievement award. “But I’m not talking about dry analysis, which is relatively easy if you know how. I do the opposite. I familiarise myself with a piece and wait for it to tell me what it’s about, and what makes it a masterpiece. That’s what fascinates.”
Widely regarded by colleagues as the “musicians’ musician” as well as the “pianists’ mentor”: Brendel’s pupils include Paul Lewis, Imogen Cooper, Kit Armstrong and Till Fellner and he devoted a significant part of his time to sharing his experiences as a musician with younger artists.
“Alfred Brendel was my guide, mentor and an endless source of inspiration for more than 30 years, and his passing is an enormous loss not only for music, but on a personal level for those of us who were fortunate enough to be guided and touched by his wisdom and insight, of which he gave so generously and selflessly,” said Lewis. “[He] was unique in the pantheon of great pianists – inspirational and uncompromising, with a formidable knowledge of literature and art as well as of music. His playing was intense and visionary, his teaching no less so – but dry humour was never far,” added Cooper.
Brendel received 23 honorary degrees from universities including Weimar, Cambridge, Oxford, Yale and The Juilliard School, the Honorary Vice-Presidency of the Royal Academy of Music and a number of prestigious awards such as honorary membership in the Vienna Philharmonic, the Sonning and Siemens prizes and the Praemium Imperiale in Japan.

data.title: Tesla Robotaxi launch is a dangerous game of smoke and mirrors
data.author: apayan
data.article_summary: Tesla's upcoming Robotaxi launch in Austin, Texas, appears to be more of a strategic illusion rather than a true advancement in autonomous driving technology. CEO Elon Musk has a history of overpromising and missing deadlines regarding full self-driving capabilities. Although he now claims Tesla has "solved" self-driving with the Robotaxi launch, this involves geofencing, teleoperation, and limited routes, differing significantly from previous promises of unsupervised, widespread autonomy. The launch seems aimed at maintaining the perception that Tesla leads in autonomous driving, especially as competitors like Waymo expand their services. Despite Musk's assurances of being "paranoid" about safety, the rushed nature of the launch and reliance on teleoperation raise questions about its true autonomy and scalability.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Tesla的自动驾驶技术（FSD）及其未来前景，特别是与Waymo的对比，以及Tesla的整体生存能力。

不同观点：
• **[看空Tesla的观点]** [blindriver] 和 [turnsout] 对Tesla持悲观态度。他们认为Tesla的销售下滑，且FSD技术不成熟，无法与Waymo竞争。他们特别指出，Tesla的机器人出租车计划是绝望中的挣扎，可能导致事故，并进一步损害品牌。同时，他们提到Elon Musk的政治立场和决策对品牌的负面影响。
  
• **[中立但批评FSD局限性的观点]** [jjcm] 拥有两辆Tesla，并且经常使用FSD。虽然他认为FSD在天气良好时表现出色，但在动态环境下的稳定性不足。相比之下，他认为Waymo的方法更优，因为单靠视觉技术不足以实现完全自动驾驶。

• **[支持Waymo的观点]** [stingrae] 强调Waymo在关键脱离里程数（Critical Disengagement）上的优势，指出Waymo在实际运行中的表现远超Tesla，预示可能发生比以往自动驾驶事故更严重的事件。

• **[支持Tesla的观点]** [leesec] 对Tesla的FSD技术持乐观态度，认为其表现良好，且在实际驾驶中表现出色。他提到一位Uber司机在使用FSD技术时无需人工干预驾驶了16,000英里。

• **[Tesla数据优势的观点]** [iw7tdb2kqo9] 认为Tesla在实际道路测试数据上拥有优势，尽管Waymo目前在技术上领先，但Tesla有潜力通过大量数据提升其自动驾驶技术。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：Tesla FSD技术是否能够与Waymo竞争，特别是在实际应用中的安全性和可靠性。批评者认为Tesla的视觉技术不足以应对复杂环境，而支持者则认为Tesla拥有更多的实际驾驶数据，未来有机会改善。
  
• **具体例子**：评论中提到了具体的技术对比，如FSD在天气良好时的表现优于人类驾驶，但在恶劣天气下表现不佳；以及Waymo在关键脱离里程数上的显著优势。

• **对Tesla品牌的影响**：有评论指出Tesla的品牌形象因Elon Musk的政治立场和机器人出租车计划而受损，这可能影响其市场表现和消费者信心。

Tesla Robotaxi launch is a dangerous game of smoke and mirrors
Fred Lambert
| Jun 16 2025 - 5:55 am PT
324 Comments
Tesla’s upcoming Robotaxi launch in Austin, Texas, is increasingly looking like a game of smoke and mirrors, and a dangerous one at that.
CEO Elon Musk claims Tesla is being “paranoid with safety”, but it is taking risks for the purpose of optics.
It’s all about optics
Musk has been wrong about self-driving for years. His track record is marked by missed deadlines and broken promises.
He said:
Advertisement - scroll for more content
“Our goal is, and I feel pretty good about this goal, that we’ll be able to do a demonstration drive of full autonomy all the way from LA to New York, from home in LA to let’s say dropping you off in Times Square in New York, and then having the car go park itself, by the end of next year. Without the need for a single touch, including the charger.”
That was in 2016, and therefore, he claimed it would happen by the end of 2017. Today, in 2025, Tesla is still not capable of doing that.
Musk has claimed that Tesla would achieve unsupervised self-driving every year for the last decade. It has become a running gag
, with many YouTube videos featuring his predictions and
a Wikipedia page
tr
acking his missed deadlines.
Famously, the predictions are about Tesla achieving self-driving “by the end of the year” or “next year.”
This time, Musk has set a clear deadline of “June” for Tesla to launch its robotaxi service.
With Waymo pulling ahead in the autonomous driving race, now operating in four cities, providing over 200,000 paid rides per week, and soon expanding with 2,000 more vehicles, Musk needs a win to maintain the illusion he has been pushing for a while: that Tesla is the leader in autonomous driving.
He recently claimed about Tesla’s self-driving technology:
No one is even close. There’s really not a close second. We felt like it was a bit of an iPhone moment — you either get it or you don’t, and there’s a massive gap.
This is becoming increasingly difficult to claim amid Waymo’s expansion. Still, Musk believes that the robotaxi launch in Austin will help maintain the illusion, even though Waymo has already been operating like Tesla’s plans in Austin for years in other cities and for months in Austin itself.
Moving of the Goal Post
We have often described what Tesla is doing in Austin with its planned “robotaxi” launch as
a moving of the goalpost
.
For years, Tesla has promised unsupervised self-driving in all its vehicles built since 2016. Musk explicitly said that customers who bought Tesla’s Full Self-Driving package would be able to “go to sleep” at the wheel of their vehicles and wake up in another city.
Now, Musk is claiming that Tesla has “solved” self-driving with its “robotaxi” launch, but it is vastly different from prior promises.
Tesla plans to operate its own small internal fleet of vehicles with dedicated software optimized for a geo-fenced area of Austin and supported by “
plenty of teleoperation
.” This is a night-and-day difference compared to deploying unsupervised self-driving in customer vehicles, as promised since 2016.
Musk himself is on
record
saying, “If you need a geofence area, you don’t have real self-driving.”
Now, Musk is on record saying that Tesla will only launch the service in a limited area in Austin and even avoid certain intersections that Tesla is not sure it can handle:
We will geo‑fence it. It’s not going to take intersections unless we are highly confident it’s going to do well with that intersection. Or it will just take a route around that intersection.
In addition to geofencing, Tesla is also utilizing teleoperation to control vehicles with human operators remotely.
We reported last year when
Tesla started building a “teleoperation team.”
Despite Tesla originally planning to launch the robotaxi service on June 12, and now “tentatively” on June 22, the automaker posted a new job listing days ago for engineers to help build a low-latency teleoperation system to operate its “self-driving” cars and robots.
The use of geofencing and teleoperation results in Tesla having the same limitations as Waymo, which Musk claimed means it’s “not real self-driving and not scalable to the customer fleet as promised by Tesla for years.
‘Paranoid’ about Safety
Musk claims that Tesla is being “super paranoid” about safety, but you have to take his word for it.
We have pointed it out before, but it’s worth repeating: Waymo tested its self-driving vehicles in Austin for six months with safety drivers and then for another six months without safety drivers before launching its autonomous ride-hailing service in the city.
As for Tesla, it tested its vehicles with safety drivers throughout Austin for a few months. Then, Musk announced in late May, only weeks before the planned launch, that
it had started testing without safety drivers
.

data.title: Windows 10 EOL
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 本文主要讲述了作者因微软停止支持Windows 10以及对硬件的任意淘汰政策，不得不为家庭中的多台电脑进行升级或系统更换的经历。作者管理着多台设备，包括笔记本电脑、台式机和NUC。由于Windows 11的硬件要求，作者的妻子和儿子的电脑需要进行不同的处理，部分设备被替换为新硬件。作者为自己选择了一台高配置的Ryzen 9900x系统，并为其他设备安装了Linux或Windows 11。在更换系统过程中，作者遇到了一些问题，如操作系统语言、Wi-Fi兼容性和软件迁移等，但总体上对新硬件的质量感到满意。最终，作者成功地完成了所有设备的升级和系统安装。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Windows 11的硬件限制及其引发的电子废物问题

不同观点：
• **反对微软硬件限制的观点**：
  - [ralferoo] 批评微软制造不必要的电子废物，认为作为软件公司应尽可能支持更多硬件，而不是强迫用户购买新设备。
  - [vondur] 以实际工作经验为例，指出大学中大量计算机因无法运行支持版本的Windows而被替换，可能导致电子废物问题。
  - [neepi] 表示不愿因Windows 11的限制而丢弃高性能硬件（如Z440工作站），并选择使用Windows 10 LTSC版本延长设备寿命。
  - [oneZergArmy] 提到其两台笔记本电脑因无法安装Linux而面临淘汰，批评厂商不开放BIOS。
  
• **支持或接受微软决定的观点**：
  - [CursedSilicon] 解释微软基于硬件对Meltdown和Spectre漏洞的缓解能力做出限制，认为此决定并非 arbitrary（武断）。
  - [v9v] 认为即使微软停止支持Windows 10，系统并不会立刻无法使用，质疑人们夸大电子废物问题。
  - [EvanAnderson] 分享通过命令行绕过限制，在“不支持”的PC上安装Windows 11，认为可以延长设备使用寿命。

• **其他系统替代方案的观点**：
  - [caycep] 建议推广Debian或其衍生版（如PopOS），并提到其办公室通过绕过Win11安装检查继续使用旧设备。
  - [riobard] 呼吁Linux社区团结，吸引Windows 10用户转向Linux系统。
  - [DanAtC] 提到Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC支持到2032年，提供了一种延长使用Windows系统的解决方案。

补充讨论：
• **市场数据引用**：
  - [personalityson] 引用数据指出53%的Windows PC仍在使用不同版本的Windows 10，显示Windows 11普及率有限。
  
• **硬件兼容性问题**：
  - [Lammy] 描述因主板限制只能使用Windows 10 v1909，但认为没有更新的体验也不错，甚至更稳定。
  
• **对Windows功能的批评**：
  - [ReptileMan] 批评Windows 11/10相较Windows 7没有显著改进，特别指出Windows商店和搜索功能的不足，唯一亮点是WSL（Windows Subsystem for Linux）。

• **关于W10许可证销售的疑问**：
  - [throw_m239339] 询问是否能在翻新市场继续销售Windows 10许可证，因许多硬件无法满足Windows 11的图形卡要求。

争议焦点：微软是否应基于硬件限制强制用户升级到Windows 11，以及此举对电子废物问题的影响。

Windows 10 EOL
June 17th, 2025
(permalink)
So Microsoft decided to produce tons of e-waste for no obvious reason. There's a lot of capable hardware out there, and it would be of software company's interest to support as much hardware as possible. Instead, they made some arbitrary reason to deprecate "old" hardware. At the same time they also turned all of windows VR headsets into garbage. We'll have to wait for the open source implementations to catch up for any hope of them being usable again. From what I read, there's some certificate issues in the way there, but maybe there's some hope. We'll see.
I've found myself in a situation where I'm the admin for 5 laptops, 3 desktop systems and 2 NUCs within the family. Except for the NUCs, all of which were running windows 10. (One NUC is running Debian, the other already had win11).
Son's PC was new enough that it just needed a BIOS tweak and it upgraded to windows 11.
Wife's PC was too old for windows 11, and had some motherboard damage (using network through an USB dongle, stuff like that), so I just ordered a new relatively cheap desktop PC. Not a beast, but more than good enough to run games. This came from
verkkokauppa.com
, of all places. I did shop around and they happened to have a no-brand prebuilt with decent specs. I was positively surprised by the build quality, cable management and everything.
My PC was technically new enough for win11, but I didn't feel comfortable not having a working system for a while, so after long, long contemplation decided to buy a new PC for myself as well. And if I was getting a new PC, it would have to be an upgrade. My old system has ryzen7 2700 with 8 cores. So the base had to be "more than 8 cores". I compared what's available at the moment and both Intel and AMD have "more than 8 cores" consumer systems at comparable prices and comparable performance. Intel's solution has big and little cores while AMD's solution has all big cores.
I contemplated the pros and cons of each from a developer perspective - on one hand it would be interesting to test with a system that has different sized cores... and on the other hand, I'd probably have fewer issues overall with a "all cores are the same" system. So in the end I went with the Ryzen 9900x 12 core system. I also opted for 64 gigs of memory, in hopes that I wouldn't need to upgrade for several years. Maybe a GPU update at some point.
This came from
Takomo
, a small local company that builds high end gaming PCs. I was positively surprised about them at almost every step. The web store has a computer builder which gives information about every part you choose. They contacted me afterwards offering advice if I was building a gaming PC (likely to suggest more cooling and beefier GPU). The computer arrived on time, extremely well packaged, with some clearly labelled boxes for spare parts, PSU cables and candy. The build quality looks top notch, and the only little glitch was that the OS was in Finnish. Not that reinstalling the OS was a big deal compared to all the migration setup I had to do.
Including Photoshop CS5. Adobe very kindly has installer for it in your account if you registered it back whenever, even though the license servers no longer exist. So I'm still able to use my legal copy of Photoshop CS5. I did leave some software behind on purpose, including UltraEdit.
I also did end up installing win11 on my old system, with the plan being to use it as a dedicated audio production system, in hopes that it would lead to fewer glitches compared to the other system which will have
all the software
.. on win10 I had random several-millisecond kernel level pauses, which isn't great when recording audio.
Which then brings us to the laptops.
For my mother in law, her laptop that's used mainly to pay bills and such, was both too old for win11 and a piece of crap to begin with, so I ordered a refurbished ThinkPad as a replacement. That came with win11... in German. After jumping through the hoops to get the system running and license locked to my account, I reinstalled the system.
For the rest of the laptops, I installed Linux. Ubuntu, to be precise, selected because it's the largest distro out there, in hopes that it would lead to fewest issues. I did not opt for Linux for my mother in law for obvious reasons - if she had issues using her net bank, using windows would make it the bank's problem, not mine.
Most of the laptops took Linux just fine. In one case I had to buy a new, Linux-compatible WIFI m.2 thingy. What do they call them anyway? Sticks? In another case I fought with the system to get hyperthreading working (the CPU stats had ht flag, but smt didn't work),

data.title: Oswald the Lucky Rabbit
data.author: benbreen
data.article_summary: **Oswald the Lucky Rabbit** 是由华特·迪士尼和乌布·伊沃克斯于1927年为环球影业创造的动画角色。他于1927年至1938年间主演了多部动画短片，共计27部。1928年环球获得奥斯华的控制权后，迪士尼创作了米奇老鼠作为其替代品。2006年，迪士尼公司通过交易重新获得奥斯华的商标权，并让他在2010年的游戏《史诗米奇》中回归，该作情节反映了他被迪士尼抛弃的现实历史。奥斯华随后也出现在迪士尼的主题公园、漫画和后续游戏中，并在2013年动画短片《Get a Horse!》中登场。2023年，一些原始的奥斯华短片和角色进入公有领域。2024年，他将出演一部 upcoming 的恐怖电影《Oswald: Down the Rabbit Hole》。奥斯华以其活泼、机智和冒险的个性著称，是迪士尼探索“个性动画”的早期代表角色。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：迪士尼收购Oswald商标的幕后交易

不同观点：
• 一方认为这个商标交易对迪士尼是有利的，因为迪士尼成功获得了Oswald这个经典卡通角色的商标权，这对于其知识产权库是一个重要的补充。例子：Oswald是迪士尼早期创作的重要角色，重新获得其商标权具有历史和商业价值。

• 另一方则关注NBCUniversal在交易中的得失，认为NBC通过失去Oswald商标换取了著名体育解说员Al Michaels的服务，这对于NBC的体育节目是一个重大提升。例子：Al Michaels作为解说员在NBC Sunday Night Football中的表现，被视为提升了节目的质量和收视率。

补充讨论：
• 有人可能认为这种交易形式不常见，涉及了娱乐公司之间的跨领域资源交换，具有一定的独特性和创新性。
• 争议的焦点在于交易的公平性，一些人可能认为Oswald的商标权价值高于一位解说员的服务，而另一些人则持相反观点，认为人才对电视节目的影响更大，因此交易是合理的。

) is an
animated
cartoon character created in 1927 by

and
Ub Iwerks
for
Universal Pictures
. He starred in several animated short films released to theaters from 1927 to 1938. Twenty-seven animated Oswald shorts were produced at the
Walt Disney Studio
.
[
11
]
After Universal took control of Oswald's character in 1928, Disney created
Mickey Mouse
as a replacement to Oswald.
In 2003,
Buena Vista Games
pitched a concept for an Oswald-themed video game to then-Disney President and future-CEO
Bob Iger
, who became committed to acquiring the rights to Oswald. In 2006,
The Walt Disney Company
acquired the trademark of Oswald (with
NBCUniversal
effectively trading Oswald for the services of
Al Michaels
as play-by-play announcer on
NBC Sunday Night Football
).
[
12
]
Oswald returned in Disney's 2010 video game,
Epic Mickey
. The game's
metafiction
plot parallels Oswald's real-world history, dealing with the character's feelings of abandonment by Disney and envy toward Mickey Mouse. He has since appeared in
Disney theme parks
and
comic books
, as well as two follow-up games,
Epic Mickey 2: The Power of Two
and
Epic Mickey: Power of Illusion
. Oswald made his first appearance in an animated production in 85 years through his cameo appearance in the 2013 animated short
Get a Horse!
He was the subject of the 2015 feature film
Walt Before Mickey
. Oswald also appears as a townsperson in
Disney Infinity 2.0
. In 2022, Oswald appeared in a new short produced by Disney.
[
13
]
He also has a cameo appearance in
Once Upon a Studio
.
In January 2023, the copyrights on several of the original Oswald shorts, as well as the character, expired. Those films and the character are now in the
public domain
.
[
14
]
In 2024, it was announced that the character will appear in
Oswald: Down the Rabbit Hole
, an upcoming horror film directed by Lilton Stewart III, starring
Ernie Hudson
as the titular character.
[
15
]
Characteristics
[
edit
]
Oswald doing a
handstand
.
While under Disney's creative control, Oswald was one of the first cartoon characters that had personality.
[
citation needed
]
As outlined by Walt himself: "Hereafter we will aim to [make] Oswald a younger character, peppy, alert, saucy, and venturesome, keeping him also neat and trim".
[
16
]
With Oswald, Disney began to explore the concept of "personality animation", in which cartoon characters were defined as individuals through their movements, mannerisms, and acting, instead of simply through their design. Around this period, Disney had expressed: "I want the characters to be somebody. I don't want them just to be a drawing".
[
17
]
Not only were gags used, but his humor differed in terms of what he used to make people laugh. He presented
physical humor
, used situations to his advantage and presented situational humor in general and frustration comedy best shown in the cartoon
The Mechanical Cow
. He would use animal limbs to solve problems and even use his own limbs as props and gags. He could be squished as if he was made of rubber and could turn anything into a tool. His distinct personality was inspired by
Douglas Fairbanks
for his courageous and adventurous attitude as seen in the cartoon short
Oh, What a Knight
.
[
18
]
In regard to Oswald's personality, Disney historian
David Gerstein
describes the difference between Mickey and Oswald: "Imagine Mickey if he were a little more
egotistical
or fallible, or imagine
Bugs Bunny
if he talked the talk but wasn't as good at walking the walk".
[
19
]
In order to make his Oswald cartoons look "real", Disney turned away from the styles of
Felix the Cat
,
Koko the Clown
,
Krazy Kat
, and
Julius the Cat
and began emulating the camera angles, effects, and editing of live-action films. To lear
44280614.article_summary: **Oswald the Lucky Rabbit** 是由华特·迪士尼和乌布·伊沃克斯于1927年为环球影业创造的动画角色。他于1927年至1938年间主演了多部动画短片，共计27部。1928年环球获得奥斯华的控制权后，迪士尼创作了米奇老鼠作为其替代品。2006年，迪士尼公司通过交易重新获得奥斯华的商标权，并让他在2010年的游戏《史诗米奇》中回归，该作情节反映了他被迪士尼抛弃的现实历史。奥斯华随后也出现在迪士尼的主题公园、漫画和后续游戏中，并在2013年动画短片《Get a Horse!》中登场。2023年，一些原始的奥斯华短片和角色进入公有领域。2024年，他将出演一部 upcoming 的恐怖电影《Oswald: Down the Rabbit Hole》。奥斯华以其活泼、机智和冒险的个性著称，是迪士尼探索“个性动画”的早期代表角色。

data.title: KiCad and Wayland Support
data.author: xvilka
data.article_summary: KiCad目前在Wayland系统上可以运行，但存在诸多影响用户体验的问题，包括窗口管理、输入互动和性能稳定性方面的缺陷。这些问题源于Wayland设计上缺少一些X11、Windows和macOS应用长期依赖的基本功能，且不同桌面环境对Wayland协议的实现不一致，导致难以解决。KiCad团队决定不针对不同桌面环境进行特定修复，而是专注于惠及所有用户的功能改进，并明确记录Wayland的局限性。对于专业用户，团队建议继续使用基于X11的桌面环境以获得可靠体验，并避免使用仅支持Wayland的系统。Wayland相关的问题报告将不被处理，除非这些问题也能在X11中重现。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Wayland与X11在Linux桌面环境中的过渡与应用支持问题

不同观点：
• magicalhippo认为Wayland在设计上故意省略了X11、Windows和macOS桌面应用依赖几十年的基本功能，如窗口定位和鼠标光标控制。这导致KiCad等应用程序在Wayland下出现问题，并主张目前应继续使用X11。他还批评Wayland对Linux桌面的负面影响，认为其生态系统的碎片化是一个特别糟糕的决定。

• poulpy123将Wayland过渡的问题与Python 2到3以及Perl 5到6的过渡相比较，认为Wayland过渡是其经历过的最糟糕的技术过渡。

• arghwhat指出，KiCad在Wayland上的许多问题实际上是应用程序本身的bug，或者是对新平台的支持不足。他认为，许多人会把应用程序在Wayland支持上的问题误认为是Wayland本身的问题，并强调Wayland作为一个新平台需要时间成熟。

• workethics通过引用GNOME相关的问题，暗示对Wayland的支持可能带来一些具体问题，但未深入展开。

• DominoTree表示自己使用KiCad在Wayland上多年，并未感到有所缺失，暗示Wayland支持问题可能并不普遍。

• Vilian询问KiCad在Wayland原生运行和Xwayland下的问题是否相同，并认为Xwayland在未来十年内不会消失。

• IshKebab反对光标控制的必要性，认为应用程序不应擅自改变用户的鼠标光标位置，并批评KiCad的用户体验差。

• duped希望了解在Wayland中缺少的基本窗口管理和光标控制的根本原因，并寻求参与解决这些问题的方法，同时提到光标控制协议最近已被添加到Wayland中。

• pomerange认为推荐X11发行版或合成器不是好建议，因为Xwayland不会很快消失，且X11本身已基本死亡。他指出，许多问题实际上是应用程序本身的bug。

• amelius提到在Ubuntu系统上使用Flatpak安装KiCad时遇到X11 cookies的问题。

• shmerl指出光标控制协议最近已被合并到Wayland中，暗示相关问题可能已得到解决。

补充讨论：
• 链接[1]和[2]提供了GNOME和KDE将停止支持X11的信息，表明X11正在逐步被主流桌面环境淘汰。
• 讨论中多次提到Xwayland作为过渡解决方案的作用及其持续开发的状态。
• 讨论涉及到技术社区对新平台（Wayland）的接受度和成熟度的普遍担忧，尤其是在专业应用（如KiCad）中的表现。

争议焦点：
• Wayland设计上是否故意省略了关键功能，导致应用支持不足。
• 是否应继续使用X11或全面转向Wayland，以及Xwayland作为过渡方案的可行性。
• 应用本身的问题与Wayland平台问题的区分和责任归属。

通过以上分析，可以看出不同用户对Wayland和X11过渡的看法各异，主要争议在于Wayland的功能缺失和应用支持问题，以及X11逐步被淘汰的现实与过渡方案的可行性。

44297381.article_content:
The KiCad development team frequently receives questions about our support for Wayland.  Given that
Fedora
and
Ubuntu
are both planning to drop X11 support from their main desktop environments in the near future, we want to provide clear, transparent guidance to our users about the current state of Wayland support in KiCad.
Current Status Is Functional but Degraded
KiCad does run on Wayland systems, but with significant limitations and known issues that substantially degrade the user experience. While you can design PCBs using KiCad on Wayland, you will encounter numerous problems that we cannot fix at the application level.
The following problems are known issues in Wayland protocols or their implementation in desktop compositors, window managers or other layers in the display stack that are beyond our ability to resolve:
Window Management Issues
Window placement and restoration
: Wayland does not currently allow controlling window position. This means that when you open KiCad, it can not remember where you last placed your windows.
Docked panel positioning
: Docked panels and toolbars cannot be properly managed or restored
Multi-window coordination
: Problems with managing multiple KiCad windows simultaneously
Window dragging limitations
: Dragging tabs and panels between areas is broken or unreliable
Input and Interaction Problems
Cursor/pointer warping
: Essential for many CAD operations, it is conditionally available in some Wayland implementations, depending on support for optional protocol extensions
Focus management
: Unpredictable window focus behavior that can interrupt workflows
Input device handling
: Various issues with specialized input devices and hotkeys
Performance and Stability Issues
High CPU/GPU usage
: Resource consumption spikes that donât occur under X11
Graphical glitches
: Rendering artifacts and display corruption
Application freezes and crashes
: Instability issues specific to the Wayland environment
Clipboard functionality
: Unreliable copy/paste operations between applications
Dialog and UI Limitations
Modal dialog behavior
: Issues with dialog positioning, focus, and interaction
External tool integration
: Problems launching and managing external applications
Why These Issues Persist
These problems exist because Waylandâs design omits basic functionality that desktop applications for X11, Windows and macOS have relied on for decadesâthings like being able to position windows or warp the mouse cursor. This functionality was omitted by design, not oversight.
The fragmentation doesnât help either. GNOME interprets protocols one way, KDE another way, and smaller compositors yet another way. As application developers, we canât depend on a consistent implementation of various Wayland protocols and experimental extensions. Linux is already a small section of the KiCad userbase.  Further fragmentation by window manager creates an unsustainable support burden.
Most frustrating is that we canât fix these problems ourselves. The issues live in Wayland protocols, window managers, and compositors. These are not things that we, as application developers, can code around or patch.
We are not the only application facing these challenges and we hope that the Wayland ecosystem will mature and develop a more balanced, consistent approach that allows applications to function effectively.  But we are not there yet.
Our Approach and Policy
The KiCad team has made the strategic decision to:
Avoid window manager-specific workarounds
that would require maintaining separate code paths for different desktop environments
Continue building and testing
Wayland compatibility where possible, but without dedicating primary development resources to it
Focus our limited development time
on features and improvements that benefit all users
Maintain clear documentation
about Wayland limitations to set appropriate user expectations
Bug Report Policy for Wayland Users
We do not investigate or support bug reports related to Wayland-specific issues.
This includes problems with:
Window positioning, sizing, or focus
Application freezes or crashes that donât occur on X11
High CPU/GPU usage unique to Wayland
Input device problems specific to Wayland
Graphical glitches or rendering issues
Clipboard functionality problems
Any other issues that cannot be reproduced on X11 systems
Bug reports about KiCadâs internal functionality that donât involve window management are still welcome and will be investigated normally.
Recommendations for Users
For Professional Use
If you use KiCad professionally or require a reliable, full-featured experience, we strongly recommend:
Use X11-based desktop environments such as:
XFCE with X11
KDE Plasma with X11
MATE
Traditional desktop environments that maintain X11 support
Install X11-compatible display managers like LightDM or KDM instead of GDM if your distribution defaults to Wayland-only
Choose distributions that maintain X11 support - some distributions are moving to Wayla

Software
88
Firefox is dead to me – and I'm not the only one who is fed up
88
Parent company Mozilla's not my fave either
Steven J. Vaughan-Nichols
Tue 17 Jun 2025
//
11:27 UTC
Opinion
I know some people still love Firefox. But, folks, it's a bad relationship, and the problems have been going on for a while now.
Let me count the ways. Back in February, Mozilla changed
Firefox's Terms of Use and Privacy Notice for the worse
. Mozilla removed a longstanding FAQ promise – "Nope. Never have, never will" – regarding the sale of your personal data to replace it with a less definitive pledge to "protect your personal information." Would it surprise you to know that a few weeks later, Mozilla announced that
AI would be its top priority in 2025
? I note that this was listed above privacy.
Good luck with that AI move. Honestly, Mozilla, what the heck are you doing playing with AI, anyway? You don't have the resources to even sit down at the table, never mind be an AI winner. Those tens of millions you're betting on AI would be better spent improving Firefox or keeping your useful Firefox sideline programs,
Pocket and Fakespot
, alive.
Pocket is a helpful program that many people I know use to keep "read-it-later" web content easily at hand. Mozilla claims it is killing that off because the ways "people use the web have evolved, so we're channeling our resources into projects that better match their browsing habits and online needs."
Tell that to the loyal Pocket users. As one Redditor
wrote
, "I'm grieving. I used this feature nearly every day and loved the Kobo integration that allowed me to read saved articles distraction-free on my Kobo e-ink devices. It's the end of an era." Not everyone would rather watch TikTok videos all day. Some of us still like to read.
As for Fakespot, this was – believe it or not – a useful AI program. You could use this tool from Firefox to figure out if an online review was a real one. With fake reviews showing up more than ever, thanks to AI, I would have thought this would have been a great program to keep around. But, no, Mozilla didn't want to invest in their one successful AI service.
Go figure.
As for Firefox itself, users are reporting a
growing number of technical problems
that have eroded the browser's reputation for reliability. In particular, even longtime users are reporting that more and more mainstream websites, such as Instagram, Salesforce, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp Web, either fail to load or function poorly in recent Firefox releases. In particular, Firefox seems to be having more trouble than ever rendering JavaScript-heavy sites. Like it or not, many popular sites live and die with JavaScript these days.
Users have observed that Firefox is slower than competitors like Chrome. Some people are reporting that the browser is running up to 30 percent slower. Issues such as high idle memory usage (2–4 GB with a single tab open), frequent freezes when restoring from a minimized state, and unexplained crashes have become common complaints, even on high-end hardware.
As my fellow Linux and open source journalist buddy Jack Wallen recently
wrote
, "What was once a blazing-fast browser on Linux has become doggedly slow. On top of that, features started to disappear (such as Do Not Track). As well, the development team seems to be ignoring the fact that every browser on the market has moved ahead of Firefox with regards to Tab Management."
Thinking of Linux, traditionally a Firefox stronghold, Mozilla's handling of Snap and Flatpak packaging has been second-rate. The Snap version, in particular, is described as particularly
slow and buggy
.
Also, second-rate and downright sloppy was how Mozilla fouled up in March with its lame announcement that an essential root certificate that Firefox used to verify add-ons, DRM content, and browser features would
expire shortly
. Because Mozilla didn't deal with the issue, users had only two days to update their browsers before losing access to essential add-ons and secure content. Without this update, all add-ons would automatically be disabled, and DRM-protected content would stop playing.
Is this great or what?
Some signs of AI model collapse begin to reveal themselves
If Google is forced to give up Chrome, what happens next?
Hey programmers – is AI making us dumber?
Guide for the perplexed – Google is no longer the best search engine
Mozilla has also been laying off more and more employees. The latest cut came in May when the company let
another 5 percent of its staffers go
. Only 17 percent of Mozilla employees approve of CEO Laura Chambers, according to Glassdoor.
Also of note is that Mozilla CFO Eric Muhlheim recently admitted
Mozilla depends on Google for 90 percent of its revenue
. Yeah, all of you who still think Mozilla and Firefox are free and independent of evil old Google, wake up. That hasn't been the case for ages. If the
US Department of Justice is successful in breaking up Google and Chrome
, Muhlheim admitted, it's game over f

data.title: DARPA program sets distance record for power beaming
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: DARPA的持久无线光能传输（POWER）项目在近期测试中创造了光能传输距离和功率的新记录。在一次测试中，团队从8.6公里外通过激光传输了超过800瓦的功率，总能量传输超过一兆焦。此次测试使用了新型接收器技术，激光通过中心孔进入，经抛物面镜反射到光伏电池上转换为可用电力。该技术能够集成到不同平台，如无人机，旨在解决战场等前沿地区的能源输送问题。测试结果显著突破了以往的记录，展示了光能传输技术的潜力，并为POWER项目的第二阶段铺平了道路。下一步将探索集成中继和垂直能量传输的应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：功率光束技术实验及其潜在应用和风险

不同观点：
• **实验地点的选择**：[inasio]认为实验选择在新墨西哥州的高海拔沙漠进行，虽然有一定的大气影响，但为了最大化大气效应，应该在佛罗里达州的湿热环境下进行实验。
• **公共安全的担忧**：[Szpadel]担心在公共空间使用激光束可能造成安全隐患，尤其是如果有人或反射物进入光束路径，可能导致严重伤害或失明，因此建议使用管道或光纤来保护。
• **光伏电池效率问题**：[petermcneeley]指出光伏电池在高温下效率会下降，这是二十年前在太空电梯竞赛中已经讨论过的问题，认为这一技术路径存在固有缺陷。
• **无人机应用前景**：[jauntywundrkind]认为该技术最明显的应用是为无人机提供额外的电力，并提出关于接收设备大小和是否需要定向的问题。
• **对未来军事应用的调侃**：[williamDafoe]以调侃的语气提到未来可能用于军事科技，比如DARPA的激光炮。
• **对天气影响的疑问**：[westurner]提出通过微波功率光束加热大气是否能影响天气模式，如取消龙卷风或飓风的形成，并建议进行流体模拟研究以理解相关风险。
• **替代高压直流电线的可能性**：[janalsncm]提出该技术是否可以替代民用高压直流电线，作为一种可行的替代方案。
• **对技术启示的评论**：[neya]幽默地提到这似乎是打开了尼古拉·特斯拉的工作成果，暗示该技术可能受到了特斯拉早期研究的启发。
• **实验地点的其他建议**：[ChrisMarshallNY]对实验在新墨西哥州进行表示赞赏，并建议下次在西雅图进行。
• **对实验展示的轻松评论**：[cryber]对实验中的爆米花展示表示欣赏。
• **对项目实际意义的质疑**：[b00ty4breakfast]认为这个项目要么是伪装成无害实验的军事项目，要么是为了在资金到期前花掉而进行的没有实际意义的实验。

补充讨论：
• 评论中涉及的讨论包括功率光束技术的潜在应用（如无人机供电）、安全问题（对人眼和公共安全的威胁）、技术限制（如光伏电池效率下降）、以及对天气和环境的可能影响。这些讨论反映了人们对新技术的多角度关注，包括实际应用、风险管理和伦理问题。

44285440.article_content:
Breadcrumb
Home
News
DARPA Program Sets Distance Record For Power Beaming
DARPA program sets distance record for power beaming
Successful demonstration of new receiver technology is important step for revolutionizing power delivery at the edge
In the optical power beaming receiver designed for PRAD, the laser enters the center aperture, strikes a parabolic mirror, and reflects onto dozens of photovoltaic cells arranged around the inside of the device which convert the energy back to usable power.
Source:  DARPA
May 16, 2025
In a series of recent tests in New Mexico, the
Persistent Optical Wireless Energy Relay (POWER) program
achieved several new records for transmitting power over distance. The team recorded more than 800 watts of power delivered during a 30-second transmission from a laser 8.6 kilometers (5.3 miles) away. Over the course of the test campaign, more than a megajoule of energy was transferred.
Previously, the greatest reported distance records for an appreciable amount of optical power (>1 microwatt) were 230 watts of average power at 1.7 kilometers for 25 seconds and a lesser (but undisclosed) amount of power at 3.7 kilometers.
The POWER Receiver Array Demo (PRAD) set the records for power and distance for optical power beaming; the graphic shows how it compares to previous notable efforts.
âIt is beyond a doubt that we absolutely obliterated all previously reported optical power beaming demonstrations for power and distance,â said
POWER Program Manager Paul Jaffe
after the results were confirmed. The DARPA-led team brought together industry and government, including the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory and the High Energy Laser Systems Test Facility (HELSTF) at the U.S. Armyâs White Sands Missile Range.
The High Energy Laser Systems Test Facility test range located at the U.S. Armyâs White Sands Missile Range on the day the PRAD team set the optical power beaming distance record.
Energy is a fundamental requirement for military operations, and traditional means of getting energy to the edge (battlefields, disaster zones, etc.) are often incredibly slow, risky, and resource intensive. These tests, referred to as PRAD (POWER Receiver Array Demo), mark an important step towards the POWER programâs long-term goal of being able to instantly beam power from a location where it can be easily generated to wherever itâs needed, opening a novel design space for platform capabilities unbounded by fuel limitations.
To achieve the power and distance record, PRAD used a new receiver technology with a compact aperture for the laser beam to shine into, ensuring very little light escapes once it has entered the receiver. Inside the receiver, the laser strikes a parabolic mirror that reflects the beam onto dozens of photovoltaic cells (a.k.a. âsolar cellsâ) to convert the energy back to usable power.
The receiver was designed by Teravec Technologies, led by principal investigator Raymond Hoheisel, with support from Packet Digital and the Rochester Institute of Technology. The technology is scalable to higher power levels and can be integrated into different platforms, such as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), to support the long-term needs of the POWER program.
For the tests, both the transmitter and receiver were on the ground, which required the beam to go through the thickest part of the atmosphere, making the test results even more impressive.
âItâs a lot easier to send a power beam directly up or down relative to the ground because there is so much less atmosphere to fight through,â Jaffe explains. âFor PRAD, we wanted to test under the maximum impact of atmospheric effects.â
While efficiency wasnât the focus of this demonstration, the team measured more than 20% efficiency from the optical power out of the laser to the electrical power out of the receiver at shorter distances. The goal of the effort was to rapidly validate the capability of a new design to massively extend potential distance, so trade-offs were made to accelerate the design and build of the test receiver. The receiver was completed in about three months.
âThis demonstration broke through misconceptions about the limits of power beaming technology, and it is already spurring industry to reimagine whatâs possible,â said Jaffe.
With the PRAD testing successful, the POWER program has significantly reduced risk for a key element of making long-distance power beaming a future reality. The program is now moving forward to demonstrate the benefits of integrated relays and vertical power transmission and is seeking the creativity and innovation of potential partners to accomplish this as part of POWER Phase 2.
A
POWER Phase 2 Industry Day
will be held on May 29, 2025.The Industry Day will promote teaming arrangements between researchers; provide potential performers with information on whether and how they might respond to government R&D solicitations; and increase efficiency in proposal preparation and evaluatio

data.title: Why JPEGs Still Rule the Web After 30 Years (2024)
data.author: purpleko
data.article_summary: 《为什么JPEG格式仍然 dominates 网络图片》一文中，作者Ernie Smith回顾了JPEG格式在过去30年中成为网络图片主流格式的历史。JPEG因其高效的压缩技术，能够在保持相对较好图像质量的同时大幅减少文件大小，使其成为互联网上分享照片的理想选择。尽管后来出现了如PNG、GIF和WebP等格式，但JPEG凭借其广泛的兼容性和成熟的技术，依然在网络图片领域占据主导地位。文章指出，JPEG的成功不仅在于技术优势，还在于其在互联网初期就建立了广泛的使用基础。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：各种图像格式的优缺点及未来趋势

不同观点：
• **支持JPEG格式**：
   - **广泛支持与兼容性**：JPEG格式无处不在，兼容性极佳，所有设备和浏览器都支持（如[martin_a]，[bob1029]）。
   - **速度与效率**：JPEG编码速度极快，且在实际应用中性能优越，尤其是在高帧率需求下（如[bob1029]）。
   - **持续进化**：尽管格式本身被冻结，但编码器在不断进步，能实现更高的压缩比（如[JacobiX]）。

• **JPEG的局限性与替代格式需求**：
   - **质量与文件大小**：JPEG文件大小相对较大，且质量不如新兴格式（如[imageformatssux]）。
   - **新兴格式问题**：
     - **WebP**：虽然适合浏览器，但在桌面应用中支持有限（如[imageformatssux]，[MallocVoidstar]）。
     - **HEIC**：在苹果生态系统中表现良好，但跨平台支持不佳（如[imageformatssux]）。
     - **AVIF**：压缩效果好，但编码器存在问题，非Chrome浏览器支持滞后（如[MallocVoidstar]）。

• **JPEG-XL与WebP的争议**：
   - **JPEG-XL的潜力与挫折**：JPEG-XL被认为是合乎逻辑的下一代格式，但因Google在Chrome中的支持取消而受阻（如[imageformatssux]，[greenavocado]）。
   - **WebP的优劣**：有人认为WebP不如JPEG，仅因未被广泛采用而受批评（如[poisonborz]，[hungryhobbit]）。

补充讨论：
• **JPEG 2000的失败**：JPEG 2000尽管技术上优越，但未获得广泛市场接受（如[77pt77]）。
• **专利与许可问题**：HEIC和AVIF等格式在许可和兼容性方面存在问题（如[MallocVoidstar]，[poisonborz]）。
• **社区对文章的评价**：有人质疑文章的某些观点缺乏证据，如JPEG被超越的说法（如[politelemon]）。

争议焦点：主要集中在JPEG的持续主导地位与新兴格式（如JPEG-XL、WebP、AVIF）的潜力与实际应用障碍之间的矛盾。

data.author: yig
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Ruben Wiersma创建的“绘画工具与数据集”库，主要用于技术艺术史和计算机图形学领域，特别是颜料映射和光谱上采样。该库包含代码和数据，使用Kubelka-Munk模型计算反射率，并通过绘画工具包展示RGB值。数据集包括九幅历史重建画作和十种历史颜料的超光谱扫描，以及Vermeer的《牛奶女仆》绘画过程的多个阶段。数据和代码分别在CC-BY-NC-SA和MIT许可下共享，包含原始和处理过的数据以及示例Notebook。该库还提供了Pigmento的重新实现，用于颜料分解。数据由TU Delft的CGV小组采集，涉及多位画家和研究人员的合作。

Painting Tools and Dataset
Processed paint samples, using the Kubelka-Munk model to compute reflection and the
painting_tools
package to display the RGB values.
See the corresponding notebook
to understand how these parameters were estimated.
This repository contains code and links to data for painting analysis using hyperspectral data. This data can be used in technical art history and computer graphics applications, for example for pigment mapping and spectral upsampling. Code and data for this type of research is often hard to find and we hope that sharing this repository contributes to open code and data in technical art history.
The
accompaying data
contains:
Hyperspectral scans of
nine historical reconstructions
by professional painters.
Hyperspectral scans of
ten historical pigments
in oilpaint.
Several painting stages of one of the captured paintings (Vermeer's Milkmaid).
For each scan, we provide:
Raw scan files from the Specim IQ hyperspectral scanner.
Code
to process the raw files (i.e., stitching scans that were made in segments, reading out spectra from samples).
Processed data.
An example python Notebook for unmixing paints with a reimplementation of
Pigmento
[
1
] using a painting and paint database from our dataset.
The data was captured as part of research conducted at the
CGV group at the TU Delft
by
Ruben Wiersma
for a project in collaboration with Elmar Eisemann and Adrien Bousseau. The reconstructions were painted by Lisa Wiersma, Charlotte Caspers, and Mané van Veldhuizen. Matthias Alfeld generously assisted in capturing the hyperspectral scans.
The data is shared under a permissive copyright license (
CC-BY-NC-SA
) and the code under the MIT license. If this data or code is helpful to your research, please cite this repository and attribute the artists (
see below
) and
send me an email
. I would love to hear your thoughts and feedback!
Left: The calibrated and stitched hyperspectral scan of Rachel Ruysch's bloemstilleven as reconstructed by Lisa Wiersma. Right: the RGB photograph used to register the hyperspectral scans.
See the corresponding notebook
for more.

data.title: Cyborg Embryos Offer New Insights into Brain Growth
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: 文章报道了一种新型柔性电极阵列，可以植入青蛙或小鼠胚胎中，监测其大脑发育过程，且不会对胚胎造成伤害。这种“电子胚胎”（Cyborg Embryos）技术为研究大脑早期发育提供了新途径，有助于深入了解青蛙和小鼠等模型生物的脑部发展机制。这一技术由H. Sheng等人开发，为神经科学研究带来了创新工具。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于使用生物计算机和大脑接口技术的讨论

不同观点：
• rpaddock认为，《Introducing the CL1》这个标题让他以为会讨论像Cortical Labs这样的公司，尤其是CL1这种包含真实生物学组件的设备。他提到，自己并不担心基于大型语言模型（LLM）的AI会变得有意识，但对像CL1这样包含真实生物学成分的设备感到好奇，因为这些设备涉及活体生物。

• ceoofballin以幽默的方式表达了对脑机接口技术的期待，提到希望看到能够直接嵌入脑干的JavaScript大脑开发工具，暗示了对未来技术过度发展的某种担忧或讽刺。

• krunck反驳了ceoofballin的观点，指出仅仅在大脑中植入电线并不能使之成为真正的赛博格（cyborg），暗示对当前技术被过度解读或夸大的批评。

• ivape提出了一个实际应用的问题，询问这种技术是否可以用于普通的脑部监测，比如在NFL中用于量化脑损伤或检测痴呆症，关注该技术的医学应用潜力。

补充讨论：
- rpaddock对LLM AI和生物计算机在意识问题上的不同看法，突显了对活体生物技术的独特关注。
- ceoofballin和krunck的互动展示了关于赛博格定义和实际技术水平的争议。
- ivape的提问引出了关于生物计算机和脑接口技术在医学领域应用的潜在价值和实际可行性的讨论。

44255867.article_summary: 文章报道了一种新型柔性电极阵列，可以植入青蛙或小鼠胚胎中，监测其大脑发育过程，且不会对胚胎造成伤害。这种“电子胚胎”（Cyborg Embryos）技术为研究大脑早期发育提供了新途径，有助于深入了解青蛙和小鼠等模型生物的脑部发展机制。这一技术由H. Sheng等人开发，为神经科学研究带来了创新工具。
44255867.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于使用生物计算机和大脑接口技术的讨论

不同观点：
• rpaddock认为，《Introducing the CL1》这个标题让他以为会讨论像Cortical Labs这样的公司，尤其是CL1这种包含真实生物学组件的设备。他提到，自己并不担心基于大型语言模型（LLM）的AI会变得有意识，但对像CL1这样包含真实生物学成分的设备感到好奇，因为这些设备涉及活体生物。

• ceoofballin以幽默的方式表达了对脑机接口技术的期待，提到希望看到能够直接嵌入脑干的JavaScript大脑开发工具，暗示了对未来技术过度发展的某种担忧或讽刺。

• krunck反驳了ceoofballin的观点，指出仅仅在大脑中植入电线并不能使之成为真正的赛博格（cyborg），暗示对当前技术被过度解读或夸大的批评。

• ivape提出了一个实际应用的问题，询问这种技术是否可以用于普通的脑部监测，比如在NFL中用于量化脑损伤或检测痴呆症，关注该技术的医学应用潜力。

补充讨论：
- rpaddock对LLM AI和生物计算机在意识问题上的不同看法，突显了对活体生物技术的独特关注。
- ceoofballin和krunck的互动展示了关于赛博格定义和实际技术水平的争议。
- ivape的提问引出了关于生物计算机和脑接口技术在医学领域应用的潜在价值和实际可行性的讨论。

data.title: Datalog in Rust
data.author: brson
data.article_summary: 这篇文章（来自Frank McSherry的博客）讨论了公共通知的功能。主要内容包括：用户必须登录才能更改通知设置，项目有180次分叉和2.1k个星标。文章可能涉及开源项目的管理及社区参与的方式，强调了用户身份验证的必要性以及项目受欢迎的程度。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Datalog的技术实现、应用场景及其与其他技术（如Prolog、SQL）的对比

不同观点：
• Leynos分享了自己正在使用Differential Datalog和Rust开发实时策略游戏的经历，强调了这是为了接触新想法和处理复杂技术问题（yak shaving）。
• burakemir讨论了将mangle datalog移植到Rust的过程，指出了Rust中不同Datalog实现的优缺点，特别是内存处理和运行时查询能力。
• tulio_ribeiro赞赏了某技术博客的写作风格和内容，特别提到文章在技术深度和趣味性上的结合，以及对内存优化的详细描述。
• Xeoncross推荐了与状态机和解析相关的技术演讲，并表达了对现代编程语言（如Rust、Zig、Go）在处理Unicode等问题的优越性的赞赏。
• maweki指出Datalog爱好者群体的持续存在，尽管Datalog的热度在下降，并分享了自己在数据质量管道中使用Datalog的经验和优势。
• akavel对Datalog和Prolog的区别感到困惑，特别是Datalog在性能和表达能力上的具体优势，并询问Datalog是否通过减少特征来提高性能和并行处理能力。
• banana_feather对使用binary join作为Datalog入门教材提出批评，建议使用更简单的generic join方法，并提供了相关资料支持自己的观点。
• 29athrowaway推荐使用cozodb，这是一个用Rust编写并支持Datalog查询语法的项目。
• rnikander提到曾有Clojure爱好者认为Datalog优于SQL，但没有深入探讨原因。
• rienbdj对某作者的新文章表示欢迎，并询问VMWare是否已经放弃Differential Datalog。

补充讨论：
• 不同Datalog实现的内存处理和运行时查询能力是讨论的一个重点，特别是Rust中实现Datalog的挑战和优势。
• Datalog与Prolog、SQL的对比是另一个重要话题，涉及性能、表达能力和应用场景的差异。
• 对技术写作风格的讨论，特别是如何在技术深度和趣味性之间取得平衡，也是一个值得注意的点。
• 社区对Datalog的兴趣和应用现状，包括其在数据质量管理和大型软件迁移中的实际应用。
